about: What the chat says about a turn that produced no answer (2026-09-27, the chat-fixes lane): one truthful line naming the provider's reason, never an apology, and the same hint in both chats. `reason` is the provider's own finish reason from `response.done` (null: none reported), `blocked` that the PROMPT was refused, `retried` that the proxy skill sent the request twice, `thinking` that the model produced thinking and nothing else. `tool_round_limit` is the AGENT's own reason (2026-09-28, core/tool_budget.py and core/tool-budget.ts): the turn spent `rounds` tool rounds and its last, tool-less call brought no answer. `tool_loop` is the agent's too: `tool` was called 3 times in a row with the same arguments and the same result (2026-09-29: a repeat counts only when nothing changed in between). Neither is ever said as the provider's. Python: tests/cli/test_chat_fixes_empty_reply.py (present_empty_reply); TypeScript: tests/unit/cli/chat-fixes-empty-reply.test.ts (presentEmptyReply).

cases.name: a broken tool call, sent twice
cases.headline: The model returned no answer: the provider reported MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL, twice.

cases.headline: The model returned no answer: it only produced thinking.
